case: A standing interest's precondition invokes a model, which is the violation layer 3 names as its own withdrawal condition.
why: This is the hard rule of layer 3: NO precondition of a standing interest may invoke a model. The guard states it twice on purpose -- the evaluator kind IS deterministic and is NOT a model -- because an enum that grows a seventh member would otherwise satisfy the positive half. Removing the negative half leaves exactly that hole. Coverage note: F6C-16 measured 14 of 30 guards exercised by a paired adverse and benign fixture, and `guard.interest.precondition_invokes_no_model` was one of the sixteen without one -- a guard registered with no adverse fixture is a guard nobody has seen fail.
